title: Two Stories About the Lantern Walk
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答8个问题。短文和问题均为英文，解释为中文。这是模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再做题。
passage:
A
Every year in our town, people walk with lanterns on the first night of the moon festival. This year, I heard two different stories about why we do this. My neighbor, Mrs. Chen, is 78. She told me that long ago, farmers carried lanterns to their fields. They were looking for lost animals while the sun was going down. She said, "We were helping each other. The lanterns were small, but the night was dark." Her story is about kindness.

B
My friend Leo heard a different story from his grandfather. Leo's grandfather said that people carried lanterns to remember a famous teacher who lived in the mountains. The teacher taught children who had no school. While the teacher was walking home one evening, a storm came. People walked with lights to help him find the road. Leo said, "The teacher was very important to the village." This story is about respect for learning.

C
I asked my teacher, Mr. Wang, about the two stories. He smiled and said, "Both stories can be true. People remember different things. The lantern walk is a tradition that brings people together." He also said that the walk is not a race. "You walk slowly, and you talk with your neighbors. That is the important part." I like both stories. One is about helping, and one is about learning. Maybe that is why the walk is still popular today.

questions.prompt: When do people walk with lanterns?
options: On the first night of the moon festival
On the last day of school
answers: On the first night of the moon festival
questions.explanation: A段第一句明确说在月亮节的第一晚人们提灯笼散步。
questions.evidence: Every year in our town, people walk with lanterns on the first night of the moon festival.

questions.prompt: What were the farmers looking for?
questions.explanation: A段说农民在太阳下山时寻找丢失的动物。
questions.evidence: They were looking for lost animals while the sun was going down.

questions.prompt: Who told Leo the second story?
questions.explanation: B段开头说Leo从祖父那里听到另一个故事。
questions.evidence: My friend Leo heard a different story from his grandfather.

questions.prompt: What happened while the teacher was walking home?
questions.explanation: B段说老师走回家时暴风雨来了。
questions.evidence: While the teacher was walking home one evening, a storm came.

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Wang say about the two stories?
options: The stories are about a race.
questions.explanation: C段王老师说两个故事都可能是真的。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: The lantern walk is a tradition that brings people ______.
questions.explanation: C段原句说灯笼散步是把人们聚在一起的传统，填together。
questions.evidence: The lantern walk is a tradition that brings people together.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: People tell different stories about the same tradition.
The moon festival is only for children.
Mr. Wang does not like the lantern walk.
answers: People tell different stories about the same tradition.
questions.explanation: 全文对比了关于同一传统（灯笼散步）的两种不同说法，主旨是人们对同一传统有不同故事。
questions.evidence: I heard two different stories about why we do this.

grammar.title: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时刻正在发生的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常和 when / while 连用：while 后面常接进行时，表示“在……的时候（正在）”；when 后面常接一般过去时，表示突然发生的动作。定语从句用 who / which / that 连接，放在名词后面补充说明：who 指人，which 指物，that 指人或物。
grammar.example: They were looking for lost animals while the sun was going down.

questions.prompt: While I ______ dinner, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was cooking。
questions.evidence: While the teacher was walking home one evening, a storm came.

questions.prompt: They ______ football when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: when 从句表示突然发生的动作，主句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 were playing。
questions.evidence: They were looking for lost animals while the sun was going down.

questions.prompt: She ______ a book at 8 p.m. yesterday.
questions.explanation: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was reading。
questions.evidence: While the teacher was walking home one evening, a storm came.

questions.prompt: The man ______ helped me was very kind.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the man 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: The teacher taught children who had no school.

questions.prompt: This is the book ______ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 指物，定语从句用 which。
questions.evidence: The lantern walk is a tradition that brings people together.

questions.prompt: The dog ______ is barking belongs to my neighbor.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the dog 指物（动物），定语从句可用 that。
questions.evidence: The lantern walk is a tradition that brings people together.

questions.prompt: While we ______ for the bus, we saw a friend.
questions.explanation: while 从句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 were waiting。
questions.evidence: While the teacher was walking home one evening, a storm came.

questions.prompt: I have a friend ______ lives in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 先行词 a friend 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: The teacher taught children who had no school.
